rewrites.comment: React Router client-side routing — every path serves index.html and the router takes it from there. Without this, a direct load of e.g. /dashboard 404s at the CDN before React ever runs.

headers.comment: Vite fingerprints these filenames (index-<hash>.js) — a new deploy ships new filenames, so caching the old ones forever is safe and never serves stale code.
